verdict.rationale: CoreWeave documents broad programmatic coverage: a CKS API to create, list, update and delete clusters, a Terraform provider covering clusters, VPC networking, object storage policies/buckets and Managed Inference, an Inference API with generated clients, S3-compatible object storage, and a FOCUS API (Public Preview) for usage export. However, the docs point to some functions only in the Cloud Console: Capacity Finder for comparing Spot placement across Zones, and quota viewing and increase requests. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API access to Capacity Finder and quota management, GA (not preview) billing API, independent corroboration of parity.
